=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:77-121; scripts/claude_engine.py:107,252; .github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:45-51 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The broker URL accepts arbitrary HTTPS hosts, allowing a smoke run on a modified branch to send its valid GitHub OIDC token to an attacker-controlled endpoint that can relay it to the real broker and obtain the Claude account pool.
  WHY: Severity differed (NIT, MAJOR, and BLOCKER); using BLOCKER because the OIDC token can be relayed to obtain Claude credentials.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1506-1530 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The shell-rewrite and unquoted-expansion checks run before literal-ID read-loop approval, causing valid loops to return `ask` and unvetted loops to return `ask` instead of leaving the decision unset.
  WHY: Severity differed (MAJOR and BLOCKER); using BLOCKER because the ordering causes 11 test failures and fails the CI checks.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:190-198 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The probe subprocess inherits `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN` and `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL`, allowing the Claude CLI and its child processes to request additional GitHub OIDC tokens.
  WHY: Severity differed (NIT and MAJOR); using MAJOR because the subprocess receives credentials that can mint OIDC tokens.
- .github/actions/claude-pool-token/post.js:10-18; scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:42-53,87 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Pool-directory validation does not confine the path to `RUNNER_TEMP` or reject symlinks before recursive deletion, allowing cleanup to target an arbitrary directory or a symlink target.
  WHY: Each reviewer rated this MAJOR; the cited validation and recursive deletion permit removal outside the intended pool directory.
- .github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:112-115, 133-140 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Both smoke checks select the lexicographically last transcript rather than the successful account's transcript, so account failover can make them inspect a failed attempt.
  WHY: Severity differed (NIT and MAJOR); using MAJOR because inspecting the failed transcript can cause false failures or miss denials from the successful run.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:46-52 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `pool_dir_invalid` early exit omits the declared `accounts` and `pool_dir` outputs, leaving downstream consumers with empty values.
  WHY: Severity differed (NIT and MAJOR); using MAJOR because downstream numeric comparisons or parsing can fail on an empty output.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:303-306 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `authorize()` calls `loadRegistry()` for `SELF_REPO` requests even though that repository is hardcoded as authorized, so a cold-start registry fetch failure refuses those requests with 503.
  WHY: Each reviewer rated this MAJOR; the unnecessary registry dependency can deny valid home-repository requests during a registry outage.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:57-62, 68-75 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Workflow-scope `id-token: write` grants OIDC token-minting capability to `collect-logs`, which does not run a Claude role, while the broker authorizes by workflow path rather than job.
  WHY: Severity differed (NIT and MAJOR); using MAJOR because the unnecessary job-level capability can be used to obtain broker credentials.
- README.md:2203; .github/ai/claude_engine.json:3 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The README says `broker_url` is empty until the broker ships, while the checked-in configuration points to the deployed Worker.
  WHY: Each reviewer rated this NIT; the contradictory documentation can mislead operators troubleshooting broker connectivity.
- tools/claude-pool-broker/src/index.ts:326 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Authorization-header parser requires case-sensitive `Bearer` followed by exactly one space, so requests with a differently cased scheme or variable whitespace are rejected.
  WHY: The cited parser rejects otherwise legitimate requests after header normalization.
- .github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:125-140; scripts/review_sandbox/Dockerfile:4-9 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The P5 smoke assertion treats any `gh pr merge` error as proof that the deny rule worked, although `gh` is not installed in the sandbox image and the step does not provide `GH_TOKEN`.
  WHY: The command can fail because it is unavailable or unauthenticated, allowing the smoke check to pass without verifying the permission denial.
- scripts/clarify_isolated_run.sh:135-204 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The Claude branch starts a background broker but has no EXIT trap to stop it on abnormal exits.
  WHY: An error or fallback exit can orphan the broker process, which continues forwarding requests while holding a Claude OAuth token in memory.
- .github/actions/install-claude/action.yml:61-62 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The version check assumes the first whitespace-separated token from `claude --version` is the version string.
  WHY: If the CLI output includes a program name or other leading text, the equality check fails and the action exits with an error.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:170-175, 177-180, 220-221 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `write_order()` does not reject an empty account array, so a future weakened caller guard could report `available=true` with zero accounts after the copy fails.
  WHY: The described failure path can leave the pool empty while the action reports success.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:97 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The OIDC request URL unconditionally appends `&audience=...`, assuming the runner URL already contains a query string.
  WHY: A runner URL without `?` produces a malformed request URL and causes OIDC acquisition to fail.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:77 parse `broker_url` from config; 95-97 sends OIDC token there | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `broker_url` comes from the caller-selected config and accepts any HTTPS host, so a smoke workflow dispatched on a modified branch can send its valid OIDC token to an attacker-controlled endpoint for relay to the real broker.
  WHY: The broker accepts the relayed token and returns the pool to the attacker.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:Lines 1506-1530 `evaluate()`, the check ordering | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Shell-rewrite and unquoted-expansion checks return `ask` before `_is_approvable_read_loop` can approve a valid literal-ID read loop or leave an unvetted loop undecided.
  WHY: 11 tests fail with unexpected `ask`, causing `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` and the aggregate `lint` job to fail.
- .github/workflows/claude-engine-smoke.yml:Lines 112 and 133 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both checks select the lexicographically last transcript, which may belong to a failed account rather than the successful account.
  WHY: Failover can make the checks report null startup tokens or empty tool calls.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:Lines 46-48 and 52 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The `pool_dir_invalid` branch omits the `accounts` and `pool_dir` outputs declared by the action.
  WHY: Downstream steps receive an empty `accounts` value instead of numeric `0`.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:Lines 190-198, the probe subshell | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The probe subprocess unsets Anthropic credentials but leaves `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN` and `ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL` in its environment.
  WHY: The Claude CLI and child tools can read the runner's OIDC request token and mint additional GitHub OIDC tokens.
- README.md and .github/ai/claude_engine.json:README.md, Claude engine section table (line 2203), vs claude_engine.json line 3 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The README says `broker_url` is empty until the broker ships, but the checked-in configuration points to the deployed Worker.
  WHY: Operators may incorrectly conclude the broker is unconfigured while troubleshooting connectivity.
- .github/workflows/workflow-log-analysis.yml:Lines 57-62 (permissions block) and 68-75 (concurrency) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Workflow-scope `id-token: write` includes `collect-logs`, which does not run a Claude role.
  WHY: A future addition of the pool-token action to that job would grant Claude credentials without an explicit security review.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_8-flash ===
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:Lines 77-121 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The broker URL is not restricted to an approved host, so a modified config in a workflow run can direct the OIDC token to an attacker endpoint for relay to the legitimate broker.
  WHY: The attacker can capture the genuine token and obtain the Claude account token pool.
- scripts/claude_pool_token.sh:Lines 93-98, 190-198 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The runner OIDC request credentials are not unset after the initial token request and remain in subprocess environments.
  WHY: Child processes during account probing retain the ability to request additional OIDC tokens.
- .github/actions/claude-pool-token/post.js:Lines 10-18 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Cleanup validates only the pool-directory name pattern and does not check that the path is under `RUNNER_TEMP` or is a symbolic link before recursive deletion.
  WHY: `fs.rmSync` may delete an unconfined path or the target of a symlink.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:Lines 1513-1530 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM
